parole.significato: sulfide or arsenide of a metal (especially about different pyrites)
parole.testo: Ultimately from Anatolian. Compare Hebrew כדכד, Old Armenian կարկեհան (karkehan), Latin chalcēdōnius, Ancient Greek χαλκηδών (khalkēdṓn), Arabic كركند. Compare also French calcédoine and English chalcedony. Doublet of халцедон (xalcedon).
